==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*vьrxъ}} (whence also {{cog|cu|врьхъ}}), from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*wers-}}.

Balto-Slavic cognates include {{cog|lt|viršus}} and {{cog|lv|virsus}}. Other Indo-European cognates include {{cog|la|verruca||a steep place, height}}, {{cog|grc|ἕρμα||reef, rock, hill}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-верх.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-верх.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Noun===
{{ru-noun+|c|loc=+}}

# [[top]], upper part, [[roof]], [[dome]], [[height]]
#* {{quote-book|ru|year=1925|author=w:ru:Михаил Булгаков<t:{{w|Mikhail Bulgakov}}>|title=w:ru:Роковые яйца|chapter=Глава 8. История в совхозе|location=|publisher=|newversion=English translation from|translator2=K. M. Cook-Horujy|title2=w:en:[[The Fatal Eggs|The Fateful Eggs]]|location2=Moscow|publisher2=Raduga Publishers|year2=1990|page2=|pageurl2=
|text=Зате́м '''верх''' бревна́ надломи́лся, немно́го склони́лся и над Алекса́ндром Семё́новичем оказа́лось что́-то напомина́ющее по высоте́ электри́ческий моско́вский столб.|t=Then the '''top''' of the log cracked, bent down slightly, and something about the height of a Moscow electric lamp-post loomed over Alexander Semyonovich.}}
# {{lb|ru|figuratively}} [[summit]], [[apex]]
#: {{uxi|ru|[[совеща́ние]] [[в]] '''верха́х'''|[[summit]] meeting}}
# the highest degree of something
#: {{uxi|ru|[[это|Э́то]] '''верх''' [[глупость|глу́пости]]!|This is the height of stupidity!}}
# [[upper class]]
#: {{ant|ru|низ}}
# {{lb|ru|arm-wrestling}} [[top-roll]]
#: {{cot|ru|крюк|бок|три́цепс}}
